conditions.ordering: Each trial alternates variant order; every cold navigation is followed immediately by a genuine warm reload.
conditions.network: Same loopback static handler; no throttling; all non-local browser requests blocked.
conditions.cache: Separate ports isolate each origin storage. Cold clears all HTTP cache and that origin storage; warm is Page.reload. GPU, shader and OS caches are shared, not cleared.
conditions.paint: Actual satellite texture drawn, source loaded and input enabled, followed by two rAF callbacks; actual drag performed after complete-terrain timing.
